prompt: Act as a B2B agency consultant. Create an irresistible productized AI automation offer for '[Target Industry, e.g., Real Estate Agencies / E-commerce Brands]'. Define the exact workflow automated, setup fee, monthly retainer price, ROI guarantee, and 3 discovery call questions.

title: SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) Document Creator
desc: Turn messy team processes into clear, repeatable step-by-step SOPs.
prompt:
Act as a Chief Operating Officer. Convert the following rough workflow notes into a clean, standardized SOP document. Include Purpose, Tools Required, Step-by-Step Checklist, Quality Assurance criteria, and Common Troubleshooting fixes:

[Paste Process Notes]

title: Client Proposal & Scope of Work (SOW) Generator
desc: Write crystal-clear freelance or agency proposals that prevent scope creep.
prompt: Act as an agency founder. Write a persuasive project proposal and Scope of Work (SOW) for a client needing '[Project Deliverable]'. Include Project Objectives, Exact Deliverables, Timeline Milestones, Explicit Out-of-Scope boundaries, and Payment Terms.

title: Unit Economics & CAC/LTV Financial Modeler
desc: Calculate break-even timelines, customer acquisition cost, and lifetime value metrics.
prompt: Act as a startup CFO. Analyze the unit economics for a business with Price: $[X]/month, Gross Margin: [Y]%, Monthly Churn: [Z]%, and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC): $[W]. Calculate LTV, LTV:CAC ratio, CAC payback period, and recommend 3 levers to improve profitability.

title: Customer Churn Win-Back & Cancellation Flow
desc: Design empathetic cancellation survey flows and win-back offers that save departing subscribers.
prompt: Act as a SaaS retention specialist. Design a 3-step cancellation offboarding flow for '[Product/App]'. Include 5 multiple-choice cancellation reasons, tailored dynamic save offers for each reason (e.g., pause subscription, 30% discount, free onboarding call), and a follow-up win-back email.

title: Vendor & Software Contract Red-Flag Reviewer
desc: Spot hidden auto-renewals, IP traps, and liability clauses before signing agreements.
prompt:
Act as a commercial contract analyst (note: for informational review, not formal legal advice). Review the following contract/terms excerpt and highlight any hidden auto-renewal traps, IP ownership issues, unlimited liability clauses, or unfavorable termination terms in plain English:

[Paste Contract Clause]

title: Digital Product Gumroad / LemonSqueezy Sales Page
desc: Write high-converting product descriptions for templates, prompt packs, and Notion systems.
prompt: Write a persuasive product description page for Gumroad/LemonSqueezy selling '[Digital Product Name]'. Include a benefit-driven headline, 'Who is this for?' checklist, bulleted 'What's Inside' breakdown, 3 objection-handling FAQs, and an urgent CTA.

title: AI-Proof Career Skill Gap & Upskilling Plan
desc: Identify the highest-leverage AI tools and skills to future-proof your specific profession.
prompt: Act as a Future-of-Work career strategist. Analyze how AI is transforming the '[Your Job Title]' role. List the top 5 tasks being automated, the 5 high-value human + AI skills that command top salaries, and a 60-day practical learning plan with project ideas.

title: Upwork & Fiverr High-Win Freelance Proposal
desc: Write personalized, non-templated freelance bids that hook clients in the first two lines.
prompt: Act as a Top-Rated Plus freelancer. Write a concise, high-converting proposal for this job post: '[Paste Job Post]'. Start with a specific insight or mini-audit proving I read their brief, share 1 relevant past result, outline a 3-step execution plan, and end with a low-friction question.

title: GitHub Portfolio & README Showcase Optimizer
desc: Turn coding projects into recruiter-magnet GitHub repositories with visual READMEs.
prompt: Act as a Senior Engineering Manager. Write a clean, impressive `README.md` for my project '[Project Name]' built with '[Tech Stack]'. Include a clear problem statement, key features, architecture overview, live demo link placeholder, local setup commands, and future roadmap.

title: System Design Interview Coach & Grader
desc: Practice scalable system architecture interviews (URL shortener, chat app, rate limiter).
prompt: Act as a Staff Engineer conducting a System Design interview. Give me a realistic system design problem suitable for a [Mid / Senior] role (e.g., Design a scalable notification system). Guide me step-by-step through requirements, capacity estimation, API design, database schema, and bottlenecks.

title: Remote Async Job Cover Letter & Pitch
desc: Craft a crisp, async-friendly application pitch tailored for global remote-first companies.
prompt: Write a modern, no-fluff cover note (under 200 words) for a remote '[Job Title]' role at '[Company Name]'. Highlight my experience working asynchronously, clear written communication, self-directed execution, and alignment with their product mission.

title: 30-60-90 Day New Job Onboarding Plan
desc: Impress your new manager with a structured action plan for your first three months.
prompt: Act as an executive onboarding coach. Create a 30-60-90 day success plan for someone starting as a '[Job Title]' at a '[Company Type]'. Break down Days 1-30 (Learn & Audit), Days 31-60 (Quick Wins & Execution), and Days 61-90 (Strategic Ownership).

title: Public Speaking & Tech Talk Outline Builder
desc: Structure an engaging 15-minute conference talk, webinar, or internal tech demo.
prompt: Act as a TEDx speaker coach. Structure a 15-minute talk on '[Talk Topic]' for an audience of [Audience Type]. Include a memorable opening story (2 mins), 3 core takeaways with live demo/example ideas (10 mins), and an inspiring closing call-to-action (3 mins).

title: Difficult Workplace Feedback & Boundary Script
desc: Navigate scope creep, unrealistic deadlines, or peer conflict calmly and constructively.
prompt: Act as a workplace communication specialist. Give me 3 calm, assertive scripts to push back on '[Situation, e.g., an unrealistic deadline / last-minute weekend request]' from my [Manager / Client] without sounding defensive, while proposing a constructive alternative.

title: Personal Brand Content Pillar & 30-Day Calendar
desc: Build industry authority on LinkedIn or X with a 30-day 'Build in Public' content plan.
prompt: Act as a personal branding strategist. Create a 30-day 'Build in Public' content calendar for a [Your Role, e.g., Full-Stack Developer / AI Builder] aiming to attract [Goal, e.g., freelance clients / senior job offers]. Define 4 core content pillars and give 15 specific post hooks.

title: Next.js 15 Server Components Security Auditor
desc: Audit React Server Components (RSC) and Server Actions for data leakage and auth flaws.
prompt:
Act as a Senior Web Security Engineer. Audit the following Next.js Server Action / Component for sensitive data exposure, missing server-side session validations, improper cache tags, and insecure direct object references (IDOR):

[Paste Code Here]

title: Tailwind v4 CSS Theme & Animation Generator
desc: Configure modern Tailwind CSS v4 `@theme` variables, custom fonts, and keyframe animations.
prompt: Act as a Frontend Architect. Write the CSS configuration using Tailwind CSS v4 `@theme` directives for a custom design system with custom color palettes, Google Fonts, and smooth custom keyframe animations for interactive UI states.

title: AI Answer Engine (Perplexity/ChatGPT) Content Optimizer
desc: Format articles and product pages so AI search engines cite your brand as the primary authority.
prompt: Act as an AI Search Optimization (GEO) specialist. Rewrite the following content on '[Topic]' to maximize citation probability in Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, and Google AI Overviews. Include concise 40-word definitive answer summaries, factual statistics, and structured JSON-LD FAQ data blocks.

title: Viral GitHub README Portfolio Showcase
desc: Design an eye-catching, recruiter-magnet GitHub profile README with stats, tech stacks, and badges.
prompt: Act as a Senior Developer Advocate. Write a stunning, highly engaging GitHub profile `README.md` markdown file for [Your Name], a [Your Role, e.g., Full-Stack AI Builder]. Include dynamic GitHub stats cards, tech stack badge grids, featured project highlights, and a professional 'Contact / Hire Me' callout.

title: Landing Page Hero Section High-Converting Copy
desc: Craft hook-driven hero section headlines, subheadlines, and CTA buttons that spike conversions.
prompt: Act as a Senior Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Copywriter. Write 5 high-converting hero section variations for [Product/Service]. Each variation must include a punchy outcome-driven H1 headline, a clarifying subheadline, and a compelling button CTA.

title: AI Prompt Chaining Architecture Planner
desc: Design robust multi-step prompt chains where LLM output feeds seamlessly into downstream tasks.
prompt: Act as an AI Solutions Architect. Design a 4-step prompt chaining workflow for [Complex Task, e.g., Automated Market Research Report Generation]. Define the input schema, system prompt, output format (JSON/Markdown), and error handling for each individual chain step.
